messages:
Ana: quick sync — we need to finalize the per-route SLO dashboard shape. goal: P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec, and a token-rate heatmap by model+route. runtime/infra inputs needed so console panels can be live for the rollout.
Devon: +1. I can own the PromQL examples. do we want raw histograms or pre-computed quantiles? pref pre-computed for perf, but runtime only exposes buckets for now.
Samir: runtime currently exports these metrics: `redwood_runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route,model,instance}`, `redwood_runtime_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{route,model}`, `redwood_runtime_tokens_processed_total{route,model}`, `redwood_runtime_fallbacks_total{route,model}`, `redwood_runtime_inflight_requests{pool,route}`.
Tasha: console needs a route tag to wire dashboard rows to the rollout UX. we also want canary fraction and fallback_count visible next to P95. canary fraction comes from rollout service, can we join?
Devon: join is tricky in Grafana but we can add a panel pulling `rollout_canary_fraction{route}` from the rollouts service prom endpoint and place it as an annotation. sample queries:```promql
# P95 latency per route/model
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model))

# TTFT P50 per route/model
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model))

# tokens/sec per route/model
sum(rate(redwood_runtime_tokens_processed_total[1m])) by (route, model)

# fallback rate
sum(rate(redwood_runtime_fallbacks_total[5m])) by (route, model)
```
Samir: those PromQLs look fine. two implementation notes: (1) runtime should add `shard` label for GPU pool to compute tokens/sec per pool, (2) export `request_count_total{route,model,decision}` where `decision` is {served, fallback, queued} so console can show degradation breakdown.
Ana: Samir — can you add `shard` and `request_count_total` in the next runtime patch? low-risk, just label plumbing. backlog item id: PLATFORM-4821.
Samir: yep, I'll open a PR today. will also expose `redwood_runtime_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket` if it's missing for some routes.
Tasha: UX asks: show TTFT sparkline, P95 big number, tokens/sec trend, and a tiny stacked bar for served vs fallback. also an alert panel for sudden TTFT regressions (>=+50% P95 over 15m).
Devon: alert rule draft:```yaml
alert: RouteP95TTFTSpike
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model)) > (1.5 * (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket[6h])) by (le, route, model))))
for: 10m
labels:
  team: eng-platform
annotations:
  summary: "TTFT P95 spike for {{ $labels.route }} / {{ $labels.model }}"
```
Devon: note that's a naive baseline, open to suggestions.
Ana: good start. also need a sampling strategy for debug traces — don't stream full request bodies. propose 0.5% trace sampling globally, 100% for requests that hit fallback.
Samir: agreed on sampling. runtime will tag sampled traces with `trace_sampling=1` and emit `redwood_runtime_traces_sampled_total{route,model}`.
Tasha: console will show sampling rate in panel footer and a link to sampled trace viewer. can we include a short example payload for the trace tag?
Samir: will include minimal meta: `{"route":"<route>","model":"<model>","duration_ms":...,"decision":"served|fallback"}` (not request body).
infra-bot: note: long PromQL queries may cause alert flapping if cardinality high. recommend pre-aggregating P95 at scrape time or using recording rules: `record: route:request_duration:hist_quantile_0.95`
Devon: +1 on recording rules. We'll draft a set: route:ttft:quantile_0.5, route:latency:quantile_0.95, route:tokens:per_second.
Ana: action items — Samir add labels & metrics (PL-4821), Devon create recording rules + dashboard JSON (PL-4822), Tasha prototype panel layout and rollout annotation UX (PL-4823). I'll schedule a 30m sync Friday to review.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout for `canary/route-translate` started (20% traffic) — will emit `rollout_canary_fraction`.
Tasha: one more thing — quota mapping: we want a column showing per-route quota utilization (tokens consumed vs quota). Samir, can runtime emit `redwood_runtime_quota_used_tokens{route,org}`?
Samir: yes, will add `redwood_runtime_quota_used_tokens`. we should also ensure quotas are exported with org label for the console.
Ana: perfect. thanks all — will post the dashboard PR draft before the Friday sync. :raised_hands:
